rules.statement: If time is not of the essence of a contract and one party fails to perform within a specified period, the other party can give notice that if the obligation is not complied with by a certain date, allowing a reasonable time, they will regard the contract as at an end.
rules.supporting_quote: "where a time for the performance of a vital term in a contract has been stipulated for and one party is in mora by reason of his failure to perform it within that time, but time is not of the essence of the contract, the other party can make it so by giving notice that if the obligation is not complied with by a certain date, allowing a reasonable time, he will regard the contract as at an end."
